## How it was tested

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Unit tests added for changes to the sentinel, network guard, vault or usage limits
- [ ] End-to-end flows run for the areas changed (`STEPS=F01,F02,... pnpm test:e2e`), if behavior changed
- [ ] README, SECURITY.md and `.env.example` are updated (for new settings or behavior)
